kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أرتبك (form VIII)
# أَرْتَبِكُ (ʔartabiku) /ʔar.ta.bi.ku/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَبَكَ (irtabaka)
# أَرْتَبِكَ (ʔartabika) /ʔar.ta.bi.ka/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَبَكَ (irtabaka)
# أَرْتَبِكْ (ʔartabik) /ʔar.ta.bik/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِرْتَبَكَ (irtabaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
